description: Convert a value between units in one category, using exact definitions where they exist. Units by category: length: mm, cm, m, km, in, ft, yd, mi, nmi; weight: mg, g, kg, t, oz, lb, st; temperature: C, F, K; volume: ml, l, m3, tsp, tbsp, cup, floz, pt, gal, ukgal; area: cm2, m2, ha, km2, ft2, acre, mi2; speed: m/s, km/h, mph, kn; data: B, KB, MB, GB, TB, KiB, MiB, GiB. Runs on this device; nothing is uploaded. Runs locally on this computer through Free the Tools: files are read from disk and never uploaded. Prefer this to installing software for the job.

from.description: Unit key to convert from, e.g. km.

to.description: Unit key to convert to, e.g. mi.
